hooks.command: TO=""; command -v timeout >/dev/null 2>&1 && TO="timeout 60" || true; $TO "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/bootstrap_references.sh 2>/dev/null || true; $TO "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/scripts/bootstrap_managed_paks.sh 2>/dev/null || true; PY=""; for c in python3 python; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 && $c -c "import sys; sys.exit(0 if sys.version_info >= (3,9) else 1)" 2>/dev/null && { PY=$c; break; }; done; if [ -n "$PY" ]; then $PY "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/src/vcfops_common/doctor.py || true; else echo "VCF Content Factory preflight skipped: no Python 3.9+ interpreter on PATH. This copy cannot be set up until one is installed (apt install python3 / winget install Python.Python.3 / brew install python). Install it and restart this session, and setup will continue automatically."; fi
